Primary layout system: HYBRID. Panel joinery is face/edge. Drum, lift, and ways are centerline from DATUM-B / DATUM-A.
Face/edge: DATUM-A bottom edge, DATUM-B infeed edge, DATUM-C inner face. Panel size,
dado locations, and screw pilots originate here.
Centerline: Drum axis (DATUM-E), both Acme screws, vertical ways, and the table midplane
all share Y = side_depth/2 from DATUM-B. Vertical locations originate from DATUM-A.
